mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in the unemployment rate above 6.5% for two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand and earnings pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE > 6.5% for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) for three consecutive quarters signals deteriorating demand, which reduces corporate earnings and equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 declines for three consecutive quarters
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of three consecutive quarterly declines in GDPC1 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate above 3% within one month signals a tightening cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when FEDFUNDS crosses above 3% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 140,000 for three consecutive months signals robust labor market strength and higher consumer spending, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when PAYEMS > 140,000 for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the Housing Starts Index (HOUST) below 900 for two consecutive months signals weakening residential investment and consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when HOUST < 900 for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) above 102 for three consecutive months signals strengthening manufacturing activity and economic growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when INDPRO > 102 for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) below 230 for three consecutive months signals easing inflationary pressures, prompting the Federal Reserve to pause rate hikes and supporting equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when CPIAUCSL < 230 for three months (t-test p > 0.05).
